description: A stereo wavefolder with a morphing fold shape, a compressor in front of the fold, an offset that makes the fold asymmetric, and separate fold counts for the two sides

params.text: Attenuates the shape CV before it is added to the shape knob
Morphs the fold curve through four shapes, 0 to 3, wrapping round from the last back to the first
Attenuates the compression CV before it is added to the compression knob
Levels the signal before it reaches the fold, so the fold count stops depending on how loud the signal is; the compression is undone after the fold
Attenuates the symmetry CV before it is added to the symmetry knob
Shifts the signal before the fold and takes the same shift off afterwards, -5V to 5V, which moves the folds off centre
Sets how many times the left side is folded, 1 to 20
Attenuates both density CVs before they are added to their knobs
Sets how many times the right side is folded, 1 to 20

inputs.text: The left signal to be folded; with only the right jack patched, that one feeds both sides
Changes the fold shape, added to the shape knob through its attenuator and wrapped into the knob's own range
The right signal to be folded; with only the left jack patched, that one feeds both sides
Changes the compression, scaled by a tenth and added to the compression knob through its attenuator, the total clamped to none through full
Changes the offset before the fold, added to the symmetry knob through its attenuator and clamped to -5 to 5V
Changes the left fold count, added to the left density knob through the shared attenuator; with only the right jack patched, that one feeds this side too
Changes the right fold count, added to the right density knob through the shared attenuator; with only the left jack patched, that one feeds this side too

outputs.text: The folded left signal, clamped to -10 to 10V
The folded right signal, clamped to -10 to 10V

notes: the fold count is what drives the folding: with both density knobs at their minimum and no compression, the shaper is close to a gentle saturator rather than a folder
menu: Apply DC Blocking Filter — puts the folded signal through a high-pass filter, which removes the offset a lopsided fold leaves behind
Enable 8x Supersampling — runs the output through an eight-times oversampled path, which reduces the aliasing a hard fold produces
